# Retained native regulatory witnesses

These four JSON files contain exact original object bytes. `pins.json` links
three ACF objects to their ZIP member and SHA-256 in the September 2 acquisition
evidence; the comment links to its September 21 named-object capture.

- `ACF-2015-0001`: literal docket RIN `0970-AC47`.
- `ACF-2006-0058-0001`: PDF/HTML renditions and Federal Register `06-04731`.
- `ACF-2019-0005-0243`: withdrawn, with reason `duplicate document`.
- `ACF-2009-0004-0002`: organization and attachment rendition.

Tests that alter timestamps, clear fields or introduce failures are explicit
synthetic controls over these inputs. They do not restate the altered values as
publisher observations. Full native/public-prior replays live outside the
repository under `receipts/remaining-gaps-wave1-2026-09-21/sr2/`.
